w: Prayers for martyrs of the Kargil war.

A kishore came to Swamishri for his birthday blessings. He said, "Swami, today I want to ask you for three things. Firstly, to have firm faith in you. Secondly, to have a profound spiritual attachment (atmabuddhi) in a God communion sadhu. And thirdly, to have divyabhav (positive and divine attitude) for all sadhus and devotees."
Swamishri was pleased and blessed the kishore with two pats on his shoulders and said, "Because of the three things you have asked you will get 100% blessings of Yogiji Maharaj."
In the Sunday evening assembly Swamishri and the devotees offered prayers for the martyrs of the Kargil war. Vedic prayers for peace were sung and homage was paid to the martyrs.

In the evening assembly the murti of Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by the devotees. In his blessings Swamishri said, " In return for our devotion to God, He never forgets us. Lord Swaminarayan remembered Dada Khachar throughout his life because he had sacrificed his home, family and wealth in the service of God. God gives infinitely more than what we offer Him..."

Swamishri performed the `Bhumi-pujan' for the proposed annexe building to the `Swaminarayan Primary School.' Thereafter, Swamishri and Minister Shri Satishbhai Chaturvedi inaugurated `Pramukh Swami Computer Institute' in the Primary School premises.
In the evening assembly the Bal-kishore Mandal effectively performed `Kafan' drama (on anti-addiction). Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly.
Prior to his morning puja, Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha for the new Hari mandir in Bhagdavada, district Valsad.
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of murtis for three sanskardhams in Amdavad, namely, Meghaninagar, Naroda and Raipur.
Medico-Spiritual Conference
A medico-spiritual conference was held in the mandir hall. About 100 doctors availed of speeches of senior sadhus and blessings of Swamishri.

Sanskruti In the evening a cultural program, Sanskruti, about the glory of India was performed by the local BAPS children and youth. Finally Swamishri talked about the work of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. Devotees and well-wishers appreciated in the assembly.

Physicians play a vital role in our society, looking after the physical needs of all people. However, problems of the body are not the only problems that plague mankind, but rather, there are issues of the mind and soul that can only be cured by spirituality.

To learn more about this, physicians and other professionals in the medical field participated in a Medico-Spiritual Conference held in the presence of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Senior saints delivered informative and inspiring messages, stressing the necessity of a balanced lifestyle amidst daily stress. Swamishri graced the assembly and offered his words of wisdom by stating, "Spirituality is what you need to give to your patients to give them peace." Swamishri blessed and individually greeted all who participated in this event.

To celebrate the third patotsav of the mandir (opened in 2004), Swamishri performed abhishek of murtis. Thereafter Swamishri performed the re-pratishtha rituals of Shri Nilkanth Varni in the abhishek mandap.

In Shastriji Maharaj's room, a sadhu, addressing Pramukh Swami Maharaj, said, "Sant Swami used to say that Shastriji Maharaj said during his lifetime that if work like this continued every year after him, satsang would double. But Pramukh Swami, instead of doubling it, has increased satsang tenfold and done ten times the work."

Hearing this, Swamishri immediately said, "Shastriji Maharaj has increased it. The one who founded this organisation and who said this, he alone has increased it. Shastriji Maharaj, Jogi Bapa and all had made the resolve, and it has grown only by their wish."
This unique devotion as a servant on the part of Swamishri touched everyone.

In the evening satsang assembly children of BAPS bal mandal presented a ballet on Bhakta Prahlad. Thereafter Viveksagar Swami gave a discourse. Prior to his blessings Swamishri was honoured with garlands.

Swamishri praised the performance of the children in his blessings and added, “In our social life we think and organize about earning more money, but once we will have to give it all up. When we were born we came empty-handed and when we die we will go with nothing in our hands. God has given us a human form for offering devotion to him and acquiring moksha. But man forgets God in his love and attachment for mundane things, addictions and sense pleasures. But we should aim to please God in human life. We are inspired to do so from the life stories of great devotees.”

A sadhu came before Pramukh Swami Maharaj bringing Jayeshbhai Dholakia, who had come from Ahmedabad. Every Sunday, Jayeshbhai Dholakia comes specially from Ahmedabad for darshan wherever Swamishri is staying, but he only has darshan standing at a distance and then leaves. Even though he has come from so far, he does not insist on having Swamishri's darshan up close. Today he had been brought in by persuasion, and seeing this, Swamishri too said, "It is good that you caught him and brought him today."

During the meal, Balkrishna Swami demonstrated the various ways in which teachers in Nepal punish naughty students. At each demonstration Pramukh Swami Maharaj laughed a lot while eating. Swamishri said, "We thought that such punishments were given only in Gujarat, but they give such punishments abroad too."
Priyavrat Swami said, "You must never have had any such experience."
Swamishri said, "Never, right from the start. I always came either first or second."

A sant came before Pramukh Swami Maharaj bringing Jayeshbhai Dholakia, who had come from Ahmedabad. Every Sunday, Jayeshbhai Dholakia comes especially from Ahmedabad for darshan wherever Swamishri is staying, but he only has darshan standing at a distance and then leaves. Even though he comes from so far, he does not insist on having Swamishri's darshan up close. Today he was brought by force, and seeing that, Swamishri too said, "It is good that you caught him and brought him today."

During the meal, Balkrishna Swami demonstrated the ways in which teachers in Nepal punish naughty students. At each of his demonstrations, Pramukh Swami Maharaj laughed heartily while eating. Swamishri said, "We thought such punishments were given only in Gujarat, but they give such punishments abroad too."
Priyavrat Swami said, "You would not have had any such experience."
Swamishri said, "Never, right from the start. I always came first or second."
Today in the evening assembly, the dialogue of Alaiya Khachar was beautifully performed. At the end, Mahant Swami Maharaj gave his blessings:

"If you put all faults together, the fault of ego outweighs them. Shriji Maharaj said, 'One who is angry, jealous, deceitful or egotistic, even if he is a satsangi, we cannot get along with him.' Could you go to the home of someone you do not get along with? We want to go to Akshardham. At the gate Shriji Maharaj will say, 'No.' You cannot get in at all. Shriji Maharaj gives strict punishment.

How many times Pramukh Swami Maharaj apologised in public even when he was not at fault! If we have such a nature, our work is done. When we leave here, we go straight to Akshardham without a hitch; no one can stop us. Direct entry. Shriji Maharaj will say, 'Welcome! Welcome!' But if there is even a little ego, Shriji Maharaj will turn his face away: 'You are the big man of your own house.'"
